The Rekindling Project

Moving beyond burnout to rediscover purpose, joy, and sustainable practice.

Philosophy

The Rekindling Project emerged from my own journey through burnout and the realization that recovery isn't about becoming more efficient—it's about rediscovering what makes work meaningful. Rather than just teaching resilience, I focus on helping professionals rekindle the spark that drew them to their calling in the first place.

Core Themes

  • Balance (Lagom): Finding sustainable rhythms in life and work
  • Boundaries: Learning to say "no" and protect what matters
  • Joy Over Utility: Valuing experiences for their own sake
  • Intentional Living: Making choices aligned with values
  • Community: Building supportive networks and authentic connections

Resources & Writing

I explore these themes through reflective writing that bridges medical practice, wilderness wisdom, and personal transformation. My writing appears on Substack, combining practical insights with deeper questions about purpose and wellbeing.
